description: Heard the end from the door, and thought better of the work.
name: Anne Shakespeare

description: Read at a gallop, and asked for a ladder or a friend.
name: Hamnet Shakespeare

description: Said Madam in three sizes, and kept the candle.
name: Judith Shakespeare

description: Read the girl, folded the sheets, and gave the verdict.
name: Susanna Shakespeare

description: Wrote both lines one-handed, and stopped.
name: William Shakespeare
